dimension_definition_identifier_shape.name: dimension_definition_identifier_shape
dimension_definition_identifier_shape.value:
("dimension_definition"."source_table" is null or "dimension_definition"."source_table" ~ '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$')
          and ("dimension_definition"."source_code_column" is null or "dimension_definition"."source_code_column" ~ '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$')
          and ("dimension_definition"."source_active_column" is null or "dimension_definition"."source_active_column" ~ '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$')

journal_entry_source_complete.name: journal_entry_source_complete
journal_entry_source_complete.value:
("journal_entry"."source_module" is null) = ("journal_entry"."source_doc_id" is null)
          and ("journal_entry"."source_module" is null) = ("journal_entry"."source_event" is null)

bank_cash_limits_non_negative.name: bank_cash_limits_non_negative
bank_cash_limits_non_negative.value:
("bank_cash_account"."cash_limit_iqd" is null or "bank_cash_account"."cash_limit_iqd" >= 0)
          and ("bank_cash_account"."approval_limit_iqd" is null or "bank_cash_account"."approval_limit_iqd" >= 0)
